episodes.synopsis: Yuke, a red mage, quits his A-rank party, Thunder Pike, because he feels they don't appreciate the support he provides. While seeking a new party, he encounters one of his former students, Marina, who invites him to join her new D-rank party.
episodes.title: Clover Is Born

episodes.synopsis: Clover's first stream has drawn a lot of attention, so they accept another quest in a forest that's been taken over by a magic beast.
episodes.title: The Forest Where a Magic Beast Dwells

episodes.synopsis: Clover's success in slaying the Zarnag draws more attention to them—and draws Thunder Pike's attention back to Yuke.
episodes.title: Overflow

episodes.synopsis: Clover accepts a quest to help promote an armor workshop's latest line of adventuring gear.
episodes.title: Shadow Stalker

episodes.synopsis: Clover goes house-hunting, and Simon tries to bring Yuke back by offering to grant his lifelong dream.
episodes.title: Mission

episodes.synopsis: Clover begins its investigation of Achromatic Darkness... and already trouble is brewing.
episodes.title: Achromatic Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Continuing the investigation of Achromatic Darkness, Clover reaches a floor of the dungeon that has... a sky?
episodes.title: The Pale, Immortal Ruler

episodes.synopsis: Yuke decides to head back into Achromatic Darkness to save Jamie, but Simon stands in the way.
episodes.title: One Who Was Once a Friend

episodes.synopsis: Shortly after Nene and Jamie officially join Clover, the party learns about a newly discovered dungeon.
episodes.title: A Six-Leaf Clover

episodes.synopsis: Clover travels to a newly discovered dungeon to undertake their first quest since returning to adventuring.
episodes.title: Clover's Back in Action!

episodes.synopsis: Clover takes their first dive into the new dungeon near Duna, and everything they encounter feels off somehow.
episodes.title: The Capital Distorted by the Twilight

episodes.synopsis: As scholars assess Clover's findings from the new dungeon, the unconscious girl they found inside wakes up.
episodes.title: The Golden Priestess

episodes.synopsis: Clover returns to Glad Shi-im with three other parties in hopes of uncovering the truth of the twilight city.
episodes.title: Biblion, the Book Spirit

episodes.synopsis: Clover returns to Glad Shi-im to infiltrate Vordan Castle and destroy the One Gold that threatens the world.
episodes.title: One Gold

episodes.synopsis: Clover must battle the monsters of Glad Shi-im and even their own allies to find and destroy the One Gold.
episodes.title: Crossing Time

episodes.synopsis: When Yuke returns from Glad Shi-im, he learns that Rain has gone to see Mastoma, the Salmutarian prince.
episodes.title: Return From the Twilight, And...

episodes.synopsis: Clover returns to Finis with Niberune, who has officially become their seventh party member.
episodes.title: The Seven-Leaf Clover

episodes.synopsis: A long-sealed dungeon in Salmutaria is reawakening, and King Vincent wants Yuke to go there and check it out.
episodes.title: King's Order

episodes.synopsis: Clover begins their adventure in Salmutaria by inspecting the path to the dungeon that has reawakened there.
episodes.title: The Dungeon Count of Welmelia

episodes.synopsis: Clover's inspection of the dungeon in Salmutaria suddenly takes a frightening turn.
episodes.title: The World Turns Inside-Out

episodes.synopsis: Prince Rafuma's reckless assault on Tenebre yields further insight into its truly terrifying nature.
episodes.title: Tenebre

episodes.synopsis: Clover finally enters Tenebre, fully expecting the unexpected... and still, what they find inside shocks them.
episodes.title: An Unexpected Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Clover heads into the depths of Achromatic Darkness to find its Abyss Gate.
episodes.title: The End of the Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Clover reaches the Abyss Gate in the depths of Achromatic Darkness, but can they succeed in closing it?
episodes.title: Beyond the Dream
